resourceTemplates.name: channel-manifest
resourceTemplates.description: Agent-readable channel manifest. Shows channel identity, active program, participation status, opportunity summary, and supported actions.

resourceTemplates.name: channel-airtime
resourceTemplates.description: Structured airtime opportunities for a channel. Lists community submission slots, sponsor slots, and superblock offerings with prices, availability, constraints, and supported actions.

resourceTemplates.name: channel-program-queue
resourceTemplates.description: Editable channel Program Queue: intentionally selected program items before live publication.

resourceTemplates.name: channel-programming-buckets
resourceTemplates.description: Persistent PP2 programming buckets derived from Program Queue bucket labels, including grouped items and unbucketed gaps.

resourceTemplates.name: channel-live-queue
resourceTemplates.description: Current live runtime queue projection for a channel with Program Queue links when available.

resourceTemplates.name: channel-programming-policy
resourceTemplates.description: Channel programming policy, allowed source types, mutation scopes, and agent approval posture.

resourceTemplates.name: channel-candidate-inventory
resourceTemplates.description: Inspectable PP2/Lazy River programming candidate inventory with renderability and Program Queue links.

resourceTemplates.name: channel-candidate-preview
resourceTemplates.description: Preview payload for one PP2/Lazy River programming candidate, including render kind, media URLs, and warnings.
